status: Proposed acceptance targets only. No Android binary or measured native results are claimed.
measurement_rules: Agree the test protocol, devices, network conditions, sample size and exclusions before measurement; preserve failures and ranges.
Use separate sandbox and production telemetry. Never mix synthetic bookings with customer conversion data.
A client redirect is not a payment or booking success. Use verified backend payment and supplier-final booking outcomes.
Native startup/frame/crash metrics are distinct from web Lighthouse, TBT or INP; do not substitute one for another.
Use consent-aware, minimal events. Do not log traveler names, email, phone, identity documents, payment credentials or private supplier tokens.

performance_targets.metric: Search submit to usable results or actionable error
performance_targets.protocol: Production-like network; report successful-result and error latency separately. At least 100 legitimate budgeted requests across representative destinations; no supplier load test is authorized by this target

performance_targets.metric: Selected hotel to usable room offers
performance_targets.protocol: Separate content/rate timings and supplier/network failures; same representative request plan

performance_targets.metric: Visible response to common native interactions
performance_targets.protocol: Measured native taps/typing/filters/calendar on fixed hardware; do not label as field web INP
First-party definition or chosen SDK definition documented; at least 1000 representative release sessions before a stable-rate claim; smaller samples remain provisional

performance_targets.metric: User-perceived ANR affected daily active users
performance_targets.protocol: Internal product target, not a quoted Play policy threshold; use Android vitals/defined instrumentation with denominators and sample size

conversion_hypotheses.transition: Successful results session to hotel opened
Payment verified to supplier-final booking confirmed
Checkout started to supplier-final booking confirmed

conversion_interpretation: Planning hypotheses, not current results, forecasts or Play requirements. Establish a real baseline first; assess by language, country, eligibility and traffic source. Business conversion rates do not gate the initial internal build. Revisit after at least 200 legitimate checkout starts without purchasing or generating bookings merely to inflate the sample.
funnel_integrity_gate: All prescribed sandbox journeys produce correctly ordered, deduplicated events tied to canonical backend outcomes; unknown/pending states stay separate. Verify exact amounts/currencies and never equate payment success with booking confirmation.
